name: Verify subagent rollback
command: export PATH="$PWD/node_modules/.bin:$PATH"; vp test run apps/server/src/provider/Layers/PiAdapter.test.ts apps/server/src/provider/Layers/PiAdapter.integration.test.ts apps/server/src/provider/Layers/PiTurnUsage.test.ts apps/server/src/provider/Layers/PiRpcClient.test.ts apps/mobile/src/lib/threadActivity.test.ts apps/mobile/src/state/thread-outbox.test.ts apps/mobile/src/state/use-thread-outbox-drain.test.ts && node --input-type=module -e 'import {spawnSync} from "node:child_process"; import {writeFileSync} from "node:fs"; let failed=false; for(const scope of ["server","mobile"]){const r=spawnSync("tsc",["--noEmit","-p",`apps/${scope}/tsconfig.json`],{encoding:"utf8",maxBuffer:20_000_000}); const out=(r.stdout??"")+(r.stderr??""); writeFileSync(`/tmp/t3-pi-no-subagents-${scope}.log`,out); console.log(`${scope} TYPECHECK_EXIT=${r.status}`); console.log(out.split("\n").filter(l=>l.includes("error TS")).join("\n")); failed ||= r.status!==0;} process.exitCode=failed?1:0;'
